title: Entwicklung eines benutzerfreundlichen kostenoptimierenden Planungswerkzeugs für kerntechnische Rückbauprojekte unter Berücksichtigung von Stoffströmen zur Ressourcenplanung (NukPlaRStoR)
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: The aim of the NukPlaRStoR project is to develop a planning tool that is specifically tailored to the needs of nuclear decommissioning projects. An optimising planning approach is to be developed using mathematical methods and implemented as a planning tool. The planning tool to be developed should be able to calculate a optimised plan and contains all the work to be carried out as well as all the material flows arising during dismantling.
